text:
alex: quick solstice standup — GPU roster check
maria: noted. what changed overnight? saw a spike in queue length for europe-west4.
jordan: we had a stray node label that took us out of the warm pool, fixed at 03:12 UTC. that caused ~15% less effective capacity for ~20m.
alex: thanks. blocker for me: APAC quota for a demo next week — need a short-term bump for ap-southeast1 gpus. who can file the cloud request? :eyes:
sam: I can take the quota ticket. will ping cloud-ops and list required cpus/gpu types. need numbers from you, alex.
alex: planning for 8 T4s + 4 A10g for the demo window (2h), and a safety buffer of 2 extras. total request: 14 GPUs in ap-southeast1 for 1 day. also need IAM role for demo runner.
maria: FYI europe-west4 still has a rolling drain scheduled at 08:00 local for infra patches — might reduce headroom in the morning.
kaya: on the provisioning side I spotted autoscaler rules that prefer nodePools with label "zone-prefer=lowcost" which caused heavier packing in two AZs. I'll push a tiny tweak to balance across AZs.
alex: can you paste the change here so I can review? I want to avoid another label mismatch.
kaya: sure — patch in the autoscaler policy:
```
strategy:
  spread: {by: zone, maxSkew: 1}
  prefer: ["label:zone-prefer=balanced"]
```
will open a PR in 10m.
jordan: re: the warm pool — I left a small script in ops-scripts that reconciles labels every 5m. running it for the last 2h, looks stable.
alex: great. sam when you open the quota request, tag me and add the demo timeframe + contact. I want approval before EOD.
sam: will do. also, quick ask: any objections to bumping spot fallback threshold from 60%->55% for the demo window? reduces evictions risk.
maria: fine with that for the window. add an explicit rollback at window end.
alex: approved for the window. deploy-bot: any alerts triggered overnight worth noting?
deploy-bot: 1 alert - europe-west4: node-label-sync failed 03:05 UTC; auto-restart succeeded at 03:12 UTC. Incident doc: https://intra.redwood/ops/incidents/4209
alex: ok, thanks. action items: sam -> open quota + IAM ticket; kaya -> PR for autoscaler tweak; jordan -> keep label reconciler running; maria -> confirm patch window won't overlap demo. I'll post a follow-up once quota is in flight. :thumbsup:
